title: A novel class of high-order uniformly accurate exponential integrators with local linear extension for the charged-particle dynamics under strong magnetic field
summary: In this paper, we develop a novel class of high-order uniformly accurate exponential integrators for charged-particle dynamics under a strong magnetic field. The small parameter $0<\varepsilon\ll 1$ induces rapid temporal oscillations, rendering traditional numerical methods prohibitively expensive due to severe step-size restrictions. To address this issue, a linearization technology that introduces auxiliary polynomial variables is employed to recast the original charged-particle dynamics as a higher-dimensional system.
